title: Closing-Years Grading Schedule: Corrected Partial-Withdrawal Charges on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
On Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts, a corrected partial-withdrawal charge whose withdrawal fell in the closing years of the surrender charge schedule is worked at a graded percentage.

## Grading rule

- Where the annuitant was aged **70** or more on the withdrawal date and the withdrawal fell in one of the last **3** schedule years, the reduced percentage of a corrected partial-withdrawal charge is **graded monthly**: multiplied by twelve less the whole months already completed in that schedule year on the withdrawal date, over twelve.
- Where the annuitant was under 70 on that date and the withdrawal fell in those last schedule years, it is **graded quarterly**: multiplied by the quarters left in that schedule year — twelve less the completed months, divided by three and rounded up — over four.
- Otherwise it is applied as it stands.

The percentage so graded, or applied as it stands, is the percentage at which the excess of the withdrawal is charged. Whole months completed are counted from the start of that schedule year (the schedule start date or its anniversary) to the withdrawal date.

## The last 3 schedule years of each tier

| Tier | Schedule length | Last 3 schedule years |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 7 | 5, 6 and 7 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | 3 | 1, 2 and 3 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | 5 | 3, 4 and 5 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | 6 | 4, 5 and 6 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 7 | 5, 6 and 7 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 10 | 8, 9 and 10 |

## Grading multipliers

| Whole months completed in the schedule year | Months left | Monthly multiplier (annuitant 70 or more) | Quarters left | Quarterly multiplier (annuitant under 70) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 12 | 12/12 | 4 | 4/4 |
| 1 | 11 | 11/12 | 4 | 4/4 |
| 2 | 10 | 10/12 | 4 | 4/4 |
| 3 | 9 | 9/12 | 3 | 3/4 |
| 4 | 8 | 8/12 | 3 | 3/4 |
| 5 | 7 | 7/12 | 3 | 3/4 |
| 6 | 6 | 6/12 | 2 | 2/4 |
| 7 | 5 | 5/12 | 2 | 2/4 |
| 8 | 4 | 4/12 | 2 | 2/4 |
| 9 | 3 | 3/12 | 1 | 1/4 |
| 10 | 2 | 2/12 | 1 | 1/4 |
| 11 | 1 | 1/12 | 1 | 1/4 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, reduced percentage 4%, withdrawal in schedule year 6 of an Ashgrove SecureRate 7, 5 whole months completed)

- Annuitant aged 72 on the withdrawal date: 4% times 7 over 12, that is 2.3333...%.
- Annuitant aged 64 on the withdrawal date: 4% times 3 over 4, that is 3%.
- The same withdrawal in schedule year 4 of that tier: not in the last 3 schedule years, so the 4% is applied as it stands.

Ages are whole years last birthday from the annuitant's date of birth, on the withdrawal date.
